yuna-songstress/cast.why: Raised microphone and hand-on-hip read clearly at battle size; clean face, teal drop earrings, heterochromia, open smile. Worst: hands (2x muddle of orange/white strokes on the raised fist). Costume residuals: narrow ribbon-tassel sash (idle: broad pink-to-blue train), orange boots with white bows (idle: tan-brown), no lace petticoat, pale blue collar with no teal ornament, eye colours on the idle's own sides, hair darker brown than the idle's auburn.

yuna-songstress/victory.why: Best face of the batch: eye colours on the idle's own sides, auburn hair, teal drop earrings, open grin; one mic and one open hand read as a clear cheer. Worst: costume (legs orange/red-orange to the boots instead of pink thighhighs, boots red-orange with orange panels instead of tan-brown, sash only a small tail, no petticoat).

yuna-warrior/hurt.why: Real recoil (torso and head thrown back, one eye shut, mouth open, free arm flung out); kimono sleeves and long blue skirt hold, boots mismatched tan/brown as in the idle; sword continuous and gripped. Worst: identity/costume (blade black with cyan glyphs and a gold chisel tip rather than the idle's broad cyan blade, large teal disc earrings not drops, red hood flares into a sizeable shape, a red cape panel at the right hip).

yuna-songstress/ko.why: Reads as down at any size; clean face (eyes shut, gloved hand under the chin), mic by the other hand, pink thighhighs, no wrong prop. Worst: edges (a pale blue/pink floor smear under the boots and a faint wisp off the hair tips, both faint at game size); boots orange with black side stripes instead of tan-brown, hair darker brown, small orange obi ends by the chin.

yuna-warrior/cast.why: Raised-arm cast reads, sword held low with the crossguard clear. Both eyes are the same teal (no heterochromia; the maker's note it was 'not clear at this size' was wrong, it is absent).
